description: This file defines a Table class for interacting with list view tables in the Superset frontend, providing methods to locate rows, click links, wait for visibility, and perform row actions.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A component class for interacting with table elements in the Superset ListView, enabling row selection, link clicking, and action execution.

methods.name: getRow
methods.description: Returns a Locator for a table row matching the exact text in the first cell.

methods.name: clickRowLink
methods.description: Clicks a link within a specific row identified by row text.

methods.name: waitForVisible
methods.description: Waits for the table element to become visible.

methods.name: clickRowAction
methods.description: Clicks an action button within a row, identified by a selector, with error handling for multiple or missing buttons.
